title: fix(spec)!: defineStack's page cross-reference checks judge components inside page:tabs and page:accordion item children
body:
Fixes #24349

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What changes

`forEachPageComponent` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` is the one traversal behind two `defineStack` cross-reference checks: the inline-action target check and the inline grid column check. It went into an array under `properties` only when the array's entries were component-shaped, meaning an object with a string `type`. A `page:tabs` or `page:accordion` item is a panel record (`{ label, value?, children }`), not a component, so the walk stopped at the item. Nothing inside a tab or an accordion panel was judged.

The walk now also descends the panel positions that `pageComponentSlotPositions()` (`ui/component.zod.ts`) derives from the component rows. Today there is one such position, `items[].children`, declared by `page:tabs` and `page:accordion`. The walk reads authorable entries only. It matches by shape on every component, which is how the exported `walkAddressedPageComponents`, the ADR-0087 conversion walker and lint's `walkPageComponents` read the same list. The existing direct-array rule is unchanged, so no shape other than a panel's child list changes verdict.

A component in a panel now gets the region-level finding, with only its location changed:

```text
Inline action 'open_detail' on page 'crm_invoice_record' (regions.0.components.0.properties.items.1.children.0) references page 'no_such_modal_xyz' (via modal target) which is not defined in pages.
```

### Why the declared list and not a generic record descent (G1)

The prop schemas already say where components hang. A row marks each composition key with `componentSlot`, and `pageComponentSlotPositions()` derives the list from those marks. Its docblock says every page walk reads that list and none keeps its own. `forEachPageComponent` was the one walk that did not read it.

A generic rule ("descend any record in a props array into any array of component-shaped entries") would also descend records that no row declares as a panel. One example is an `object-master-detail-form` `details[]` entry. The renderer draws nothing from such a record, and an entry with a `type` key looks like a component. That is the false-positive edge. The declared list follows the schemas and names no component type: a custom type that composes `items[].children` is judged too, as the other walks judge it. Controls pin what is not walked:

- a panel record's own keys;
- a child list holding no component;
- a `details[]` entry with a `type` key and a `children` list;
- a panel-shaped list under an undeclared key;
- an undeclared key inside a declared panel.

## Premises, verified on `origin/main` `31e7d0ba2`

- **P1, holds.** `forEachPageComponent` (`stack.zod.ts:2406`) visits `regions[].components[]` and `slots.NAME`. From each node it recurses only into `properties` arrays whose entries pass `isComponentNode` (`:2384`, a record with a string `type`). `PageTabsProps.items[]` is a closed object with no `type` key (`ui/component.zod.ts:874`), so the walk stopped there. The probe below measures it.
- **P2, holds.** Read from the rows, not from the card's list: the `componentSlot` marks at base are `children` on the thin containers (`:587`) and on `page:card` (`:1047`), `footer` on `page:card` (`:1069`), retired `body` on `page:card` (`:1057`), and `items[].children` on `page:tabs` (`:997`) and `page:accordion` (`:2726`). The derived list prints those four positions; the only one reached through an item record is `items[].children`. As an independent read, the other `z.array(z.unknown())` keys in the rows hold records (`data` / `staticData`), not components. The other `items` arrays (`element:definition-list`, the timeline items, the gantt bars) have no `children`. So the item-record positions are exactly tabs and accordion.
- **P3, holds.** The callers are `collectInlinePageActions` (`:2475`, walk at `:2480`) and `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` (`:3583`, walk at `:3645`). At region level, both refuse with `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, status 422, and a located path.
- **P4: lint has a different walk, with no gap in the component-props gate.** `validateComponentProps` walks through `walkPageComponents` (`packages/lint/src/page-walk.ts`). That walk reads `pageComponentSlotPositions()` (non-retired entries, `items[].children` included) and is pinned at `validate-component-props.test.ts:152`. It is not the same walk as `forEachPageComponent`, so it is not changed here. Lint's other page rules use the same shared walk, with one exception: `validateResponsiveStyles` (`validate-responsive-styles.ts:100`, `:187`). That rule keeps its own walk over `regions[].components[]` only. It descends `children` and `body` and skips slots, `footer` and `items[].children`, so it has the same kind of gap through a different walk. It is not changed here (see Acceptance notes).

## Public-door probe (G6)

The probe calls `defineStack` with one record page and a declared child object. The button is an inline `type: 'modal'` action with a dangling `target`. The column is an identity-only `scale` column over a `currency` child field.

| component placed at | `31e7d0ba2` (base) | this head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| button, region | refused, 422, `(regions.0.components.0)` | refused, same |
| button, `page:tabs` `items[1].children` | **accepted** | refused, 422, `(regions.0.components.0.properties.items.1.children.0)` |
| button, `page:accordion` `items[0].children` | **accepted** | refused, 422, `(…properties.items.0.children.0)` |
| `record:line_items` column, region | refused, 422 | refused, same |
| `record:line_items` column, `page:tabs` `items[1].children` | **accepted** | refused, 422, region-level message at `(…properties.items.1.children.0)` |

A page whose tabs item contains the tabs node itself (a cycle) is accepted and terminates on both base and head.

## Sentences re-trued (G3)

- `stack.zod.ts`:
  - The `forEachPageComponent` docblock ("reaches every container spelling") now states three traversal facts, panels among them.
  - The inline-action docblock ("every root, every nesting") was false on base and is true now; it now names the panels.
  - The grid-column docblock's line-items bullet ("a block under a `page:tabs` item's `children` is not yet visited") is rewritten.
- `18.ui-record-line-items-props-closed.ts`: its reason's "reach: a block under a `page:tabs` item's `children` is not yet judged" now names the panel positions in the reach.
- `registry.ts.template`: the `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment `ui-record-line-items-props-closed` carried the same sentence and is re-trued the same way. The template is also where the new entry's fragment goes.
- `ui/component.zod.ts`: at `31e7d0ba2` the `RecordLineItemsProps` TSDoc names no tabs exclusion (`:2440`–`:2538`), so that file is untouched.
- The master-detail siblings (`18.ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed.ts:46`, template `:3092`, "reaches the block wherever a page carries it") were false on base and are true after the walk change, so they are unchanged.

## In-repo producers (G4)

Four authored pages nest components under a panel item. Each was built through `defineStack` on this head, with this worktree's `packages/spec/dist` resolved and a positive control (a dangling button under a tab) refused in the same run:

- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts`, with the 22 showcase objects;
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`;
- `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-organization.page.ts`;
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.page.ts`.

All four build. None holds an inline action target or an identity-only typed-key column under a panel; the showcase `record:line_items` block declares a `type` on all five columns. One documentation example nests record blocks under tabs (`content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`), with nothing the checks judge. The published skills carry no `page:tabs` or `page:accordion` (zero hits, with the control term `page:card` hitting). No producer edit was needed.

## ADR-0087 disposition (G5)

The changeset `.changeset/24349-page-walk-panel-children.md` contains:

- the `!` title;
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`;
- one ADR-0087 marker, of the `registered` kind, naming the new step-18 semantic entry `ui-page-panel-children-cross-references-judged`. Its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment is at order 103. No existing entry records the inline-action target refusal, so `already-registered` could not cover that half;
- a FROM → TO table.

`check:adr-0087-registration` passes it: `registered ui-page-panel-children-cross-references-judged (new here: …)`.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/stack-page-walk-panels.test.ts`, 16 tests. Each refusal is pinned against its region-level twin: the same component built at `regions.0.components.0` gives the reference finding, and the panel case must equal it with only the location changed. Each case asserts `code`, `status` and the whole `issues` list. It covers both callers (the inline action, `record:line_items`, `object-master-detail-form`) under tabs, under accordion, and in tabs nested in an accordion panel. It also covers a panel inside a container, a panel under a slot, two panels reporting in document order, every declared panel position on a custom type, the remedies, and the controls listed above.
- Ablation (the new tests import `./stack.zod` source, so there is no `dist` leg). `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` disabled the panel loop: the anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob from `a35d4fb7` to `7d7d6e30`. The run went 14 failed, 2 passed: the panel-record control and the remedy stay green. The undeclared-key control goes red only through its own positive-twin assertion. The restore was proven by the tool: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- At `bb9d44234`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 697 files, 21267 passed, 1 todo, `VERDICT command-exit 0`;
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`;
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14 of 14 artifacts up to date.

  The later commits up to the final head `3d635d4cc` changed no file under `packages/spec` or `packages/lint`: the merges `b0f8b9e3c`, `f5e6ad17d` and `3d635d4cc`, and patch round 1's changeset-only commit `e9303fbbc`. These readings hold for the final tree.

## Gates

- **Local, on the final head `3d635d4cc` (patch round 1).** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived the same 91 commands from 7 changed paths against merge base `71fa166e9`. All 91 ran, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, and 90 exit 0. `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exits 1 by design, because this PR changes a changeset it did not add (see the section above). `--ran` reconciliation: `91 derived, 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0.
- **Before patch round 1, at `b0f8b9e3c`.** The same 91 commands against merge base `ee882b845`: `91 derived, 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, all exit 0.
- **First run, at `bb9d44234`.** The same 91-command list (merge base `31e7d0ba2`) had 3 exit-3 prerequisite refusals: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`, each because a sibling package was not built. On the final head all three ran and passed.
- **Local-only family.** `pnpm check:dev-prereqs`: exit 0, at `b0f8b9e3c` and again at `3d635d4cc`.
- **Not run locally.** The whole farm, and the CI jobs the derivation names as CI's own shell (the `Test Core` shards, `Build Core`, the type-check program steps), are CI's. This PR's check-runs are their record.

## Pending release note corrected (patch round 1)

This PR also edits `.changeset/24190-line-items-hydrated-check.md`, another PR's release note. It is still pending on `main` and unreleased, so it ships in the same release as this PR's changeset. The seat extended this claim's file surface to that one file (REWORK `6257450280`). This change made two of its sentences false. Both are now true at release:

- `:15` said "A block under a `page:tabs` item's `children` is not yet judged." That sentence is gone. The sentence before it now says the check reaches the block "in a slot and, since #24349, in a `page:tabs` or `page:accordion` item's `children`".
- `:28` said the showcase project detail block sits "under a `page:tabs` item, so not yet judged". It keeps its dated reading on `ec749fbb44` and drops "so not yet judged".

Nothing else in that note changed (lines 15 and 28 only): its frontmatter, `Clause-②` line, ADR-0087 marker, FROM → TO table and figures are as they were. This PR's own changeset cited the old sentence ("which the entry that brought the block's identity-only check lists as not yet judged"). It now says "That includes a `record:line_items` block in a tab or accordion panel, a position the block's identity-only check did not reach before this change."

`Check Changeset` stays red on this PR by design. `check-empty-changeset` refuses a PR that changes a changeset it did not add, and names this the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class. Its remedy is this written confirmation on the PR, not the `skip-changeset` label and not restoring the old text. `Check Changeset` is not one of the five required contexts.

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/lint`'s `validateResponsiveStyles` keeps its own regions-only walk (`children` / `body`; no slots, `footer` or panels), so a `responsiveStyles` node inside a tab is not checked by its five style rules. No in-repo producer puts `responsiveStyles` in a panel, footer or slot, and no public door was measured, so this is noted and not filed. Carrier: none.
- The `pageComponentSlotPositions()` docblock (`ui/component.zod.ts:8648`) names three readers; `forEachPageComponent` is now a fourth. The list is illustrative and is not edited (outside the claim's surface).
- The direct-array rule in `forEachPageComponent` still reaches undeclared keys and the retired `page:card.body`, as it did on base. Narrowing it to the declared direct slots would change the verdict of shapes other than a panel's children, so it is left as it is.
